review_comments.body:
This module mock replaces the loader table for other test files in the same Bun process, so the existing loader suite fails instead of using the real table. Please isolate this mock so it cannot affect the other tests.

<details><summary>Technical details</summary>

````markdown
# Thumbnail test contaminates the loader suite

## Affected sites
- `packages/studio/src/test/render-effect-thumbnail.test.ts:19` — the mocked loader table only contains blur.
- `packages/studio/src/test/effect-preview-loaders.test.ts:9` — the catalog tests see that mocked table.

## Required outcome
- `bun test packages/studio/src/test/render-effect-thumbnail.test.ts packages/studio/src/test/effect-preview-loaders.test.ts` must pass in one process. Currently the thumbnail tests pass, but all 91 loader tests fail; the loader suite passes on its own.
````

</details>
